limits: The carrier uses two existing camera mounting holes and M2x14 screws with three 0.5 mm washers at each head; it does not load the autofocus barrel or housing.
The ring PCB snaps beneath four short side lips, separated from the camera washer stacks. Verify retention and solder-wire clearance on the actual print.
Camera component envelopes, screw lengths and the unidentified YAM drive require incoming/installed fit acceptance.
Only local LED wire departure and the camera-lid cable opening are specified; size and secure full cable slack on the actual gripper.
The white overcoat is a nominal process envelope, not a calibrated optical surface.
